title: Recurring tasks not show on next due date is a deal breaker
body:
The app has everything you need regarding getting on top of everything except for one crucial thing.

If you create a task and make it recurring it will only show you the nearest due date and only show you the next due date after you press completed on the last one. That makes it impossible to fit in tasks in the following days, weeks or months because you basically cannot tell how busy your schedule is unless of course you memorise all those recurring tasks.

That defies the whole purpose of having a planner.

title: App-solutely fantastic!
body:
I really like this app.  I have searched for years for a good organiser (and like others, I have purchased other solutions) and this one works for me.

I really love its simplicity and user-friendly interface.  Its easy to create a project and add tasks as you think of them (I also create a mindmap of each project so I can better see everything I need to do, I use Xmind for this).  This is proving to be really successful for me to keep track of things, especially client projects.

I like the fact that I can print out projects and each task has a checkbox beside it.  

I love being able to work across platforms as I can add stuff regardless of what I'm doing at the time.

The task reminders are great - you can get reminders on your phone or by email.

Since getting the app, I have decided to use it to record everything - business & personal events, projects etc.  And I can see these in iCal.

There are a few small things on my wish list, but not big enough to reduce my rating of this app...I have the subscription version so I can add notes to tasks, but I'd really like to add notes to the project itself - for things like a project intro, objectives and things I need to remember but don't want to add to a task. And I'd like the notes to be displayed when I'm looking at the project (I dont want to have to click to see the note).

Also, when collaborating, the other person's tasks come up in my calendar and are included as part of my reminders - I'd prefer to hide these.

But overall, a great productivity tool in any situation.
